# display tree 

```{r}

# Load the tree and tip data
tree <- read.nexus("../OLD_trees/Dennytree_timed_with_nucLSU.tre") %>% ladderize(right=F)
new_tips <- read.csv("spreadsheets/tip_update.csv")
tree$tip.label <- as.character(new_tips[[2]][match(tree$tip.label, new_tips[[1]])])

# Color the subtrees (states: 1, 2, 3, 4)
compTree_colored <- tree
compTree_colored <- paintSubTree(compTree_colored, node=109, state="Outgroup", stem=F)
compTree_colored <- paintSubTree(compTree_colored, node=115, state="Decomposer", stem=T)
compTree_colored <- paintSubTree(compTree_colored, node=124, state="Inopinata", stem=T)
compTree_colored <- paintSubTree(compTree_colored, node=127, state="Ectomycorrhizal", stem=T)

# Extract tree data for plotting
p <- ggtree(compTree_colored, layout="circular")
tree_data <- p$data

# 🔄 Manually annotate state per node using node ancestry
tree_data <- tree_data %>%
  mutate(state = case_when(
    node >= 109 & node < 115 ~ "Outgroup",
    node >= 115 & node < 124 ~ "Decomposer",
    node >= 124 & node < 127 ~ "Inopinata",
    node >= 127              ~ "Ectomycorrhizal"))

# Define colors that match the corrected state values
cols <- c("Outgroup" = "black",
          "Decomposer" = "green",
          "Inopinata" = "purple",
          "Ectomycorrhizal" = "orange")  

# 🌿 Final nicely formatted tree with colored branches
p %+% tree_data + 
  geom_tree(aes(color=state), size=1) + 
  geom_tiplab(size=2.5, offset=0.02, aes(angle=angle)) +
  scale_color_manual(name="Niche Group", values=cols, na.translate=FALSE) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(face="bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size=10),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold", size=16),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Phylogenetic Tree of *Amanita*: Spore Shape vs. Niche") +
  theme_transparent()  # Clean background


```

# import spore shapes
# Morphometic analysis
```{r, label="import spores",results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Import outlines: First list jpeg files to import

jpg.list <- list.files("outlines", pattern=c( ".jpg"), full.names=TRUE) 

# import them

spores <- Momocs::import_jpg(jpg.paths = jpg.list, auto.notcentered = T)
out_spores <- Momocs::Out(spores)
out_spores <- Momocs::coo_center(out_spores)
out_spores_scaled <- Momocs::coo_scale(out_spores)
out_spores_smoothed <- Momocs::coo_smooth(out_spores_scaled, n = 5)
# Ensure all outlines have the same number of points (e.g., 100 points per outline)
out_spores_interp <- Momocs::coo_interpolate(out_spores_smoothed, n = 120)
# Now apply Procrustes alignment
out_spores_aligned <- Momocs::fgProcrustes(out_spores_interp)
# Visualize to confirm
panel(out_spores_aligned, title = "Aligned Amanita Spores after Resampling")
efourier_spores <- Momocs::efourier(out_spores_scaled, nb.h = 21, norm = TRUE)
pca_spores <- Momocs::PCA(efourier_spores)

```

```{r, label="import spores",results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Import outlines: First list jpeg files to import

jpg.list <- list.files("outlines", pattern=c( ".jpg"), full.names=TRUE) 

# import them

spores <- import_jpg(jpg.paths = jpg.list, auto.notcentered = T)

# create an Out object

spores <- Out(spores)

# get names of the files to extract the species name

image_names <- data.frame(names(spores))
colnames(image_names) <- "image_name"

# now extract the epithet to calculate a mean shape for the outlines of each species

species <- colsplit(image_names$image_name,"_",names=c("genus","epithet","author"))
species$genus <- gsub("Amanita","A",species$genus)
species$species <- paste0(species$genus,"_",species$epithet) %>% as.factor

# Import groups by clade

groups <- read.csv("spreadsheets/Amanita_spore_groups.csv")

# join species with outlines and groups

groups <- left_join(species, groups, "species")

#groups$in_tree <- as.character(groups$in_tree)
#groups$in_tree[is.na(groups$in_tree)] <- "no"
#groups$clade <- as.character(groups$clade)
#groups$clade[is.na(groups$clade)] <- "not_in_tree"
groups[] <- lapply(groups[], factor)

# assign groups

spores$fac <- groups
```

```{r, label="elliptic Fourier analysis", echo=FALSE, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=6, fig.align='center'}
# Check how many harmonics are needed to achieve say 99% variation

#calibrate_harmonicpower_efourier(spores)

# elliptic Fourier analysis

efou_spores <- efourier(spores, norm=T, nb.h=21) 

# PCA

pca_efou_spores <- PCA(efou_spores)
```

## Fig. 3

```{r, label="Mean shape morphospace", fig.height=3.25, fig.width=7, fig.align='center', echo=FALSE, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Calculate the mean shape for each species

spore_means <- MSHAPES(efou_spores, 'species') 
spore_means <- PCA(spore_means$Coe)
#spore_mean_groups <- spore_means$fac %>% data.frame() %>% setNames("species")
#spore_mean_groups <-  join(spore_mean_groups, groups, match="first")
#spore_means$fac <- spore_mean_groups

# Plot the morphospaces with the species means


plot_PCA(spore_means, ~clade_guessed, morphospace=F, points=T,chull=F,
         zoom=1, center_origin = F,eigen=F,legend=F,
    palette=colorRampPalette(c("deepskyblue","purple","orange","black"))) %>%
    layer_box(border="black",lwd=2) %>%
    layer_points(cex=0.01) %>%
    layer_axesvar %>%
    layer_morphospace_PCA(rotate=-1.5,size=0.75, nr = 8, nc = 4) %>% 
    layer_chull(lty=0) %>%
    layer_chullfilled(alpha = 0.8) 

legend(-0.24,0.04,legend=c("Decomposer", "Inopinata","Ectomycorrhizal","outgroup"),inset=0,pch=16, col=c("deepskyblue","purple","orange","black"),adj=0,  cex=0.5, pt.cex=0.65, bty="n",y.intersp = 0.35)

#legend(-0.24,0.04,legend=c("A"),inset=0,adj=0,cex=1, pt.cex=0.75, bty="n",y.intersp = 0.45)

plot_PCA(spore_means, ~clade_guessed, morphospace=F, points=T,chull=F,axes=c(1,3),
         zoom=1, center_origin = F,eigen=F,legend=F,
    palette=colorRampPalette(c("deepskyblue","purple","orange","black"))) %>%
```

```{r, label="update tree tips", fig.height=10, fig.width=10, fig.align='center', echo=FALSE, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# save PCs
pcs_spores <- as_df(spore_means)
pcs_spores <- pcs_spores[c(4,10:12,5:9)]
rownames(pcs_spores) <- pcs_spores$species

#write.csv(pcs_spores,"spreadsheets/pc_Scores_Amanita.csv", row.names=F)

# Match tree and data
compData <- treedata(tree, pcs_spores)
compTree <- compData$phy
compData <- compData$data %>% data.frame()
compData[,2:4] <- sapply(compData[,2:4], as.character) %>% as.numeric
```

```{r, label="phylANOVA",fig.height=6, fig.width=7, fig.align='center', echo=FALSE, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Drop outgroup for phylanova
amanita_only_tree <- extract.clade(compTree, node=88) 

compData_phylANOVA <- treedata(amanita_only_tree, pcs_spores)
compTree_phylANOVA <- compData_phylANOVA$phy
compData_phylANOVA <- compData_phylANOVA$data %>% data.frame()
compData_phylANOVA[,2:4] <- sapply(compData_phylANOVA[,2:4], as.character) %>% as.numeric
compData_phylANOVA <- join(compData_phylANOVA,groups,match="first")

compData_phylANOVA_clade<-compData_phylANOVA$clade
names(compData_phylANOVA_clade)<-row.names(compData_phylANOVA)
compData_phylANOVA_PC1<-compData_phylANOVA$PC1
names(compData_phylANOVA_PC1)<-row.names(compData_phylANOVA)

phylANOVA(compTree_phylANOVA, compData_phylANOVA_clade, compData_phylANOVA_PC1, nsim=1000, posthoc=F, p.adj="holm")
```

```{r, label="Ornstein-Uhlenbeck",fig.height=6, results="hide",fig.width=8, fig.align='center',eval=T, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
spore_length_width<-read.csv("spreadsheets/Sporelengthwidth.csv")
PC1OUdata<-compData%>%filter(species%in%spore_length_width$species)
PC1OUtree<-drop.tip(compTree,compTree$tip.label[!compTree$tip.label%in%spore_length_width$species])

row.names(PC1OUdata)<-PC1OUdata$species
PC1OUdata<-as.matrix(PC1OUdata[,c(2:4)])[,1]

l1ouPC1tree<-adjust_data(PC1OUtree,PC1OUdata)
set.seed(101)

##update tip labels

row.names(estimate_shift_PC1$Y)<-as.character(new_tips[[3]][match(row.names(estimate_shift_PC1$Y), new_tips[[2]])])

plot(estimate_shift_PC1, cex=0.5) #, edge.label=e.l, edge.ann.cex=0.7, edge.label.ann=TRUE, label.offset=0.02, edge.width=e.w)
```

## Fig. S1

```{r, label="All species cophylogeny tree", fig.height=8, fig.width=6, fig.align='center', echo=FALSE, cache=FALSE,results=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Ben<-read.nexus("phylogenetics/Finaltrees/Bentree_timed_with_nucLSU.tre")
Denny<-read.nexus("phylogenetics/Finaltrees/Dennytree_timed_with_nucLSU.tre")
namematch<-read.csv("spreadsheets/tip_update.csv")

Ben$tip.label<-as.character(namematch[[3]][match(Ben$tip.label, namematch[[1]])])
Denny$tip.label<-as.character(namematch[[3]][match(Denny$tip.label, namematch[[1]])])

obj<-cophylo(Denny,Ben,rotate=TRUE)
obj$trees[[1]]<-rotateNodes(obj$trees[[1]],116)
obj$trees[[2]]<-rotateNodes(obj$trees[[2]],115)
obj$trees[[1]]<-rotateNodes(obj$trees[[1]],109)
obj$trees[[2]]<-rotateNodes(obj$trees[[2]],109)

obj$trees[[1]]<-rotateNodes(obj$trees[[1]],159)
obj$trees[[2]]<-rotateNodes(obj$trees[[2]],157)
#plot(obj$trees[[1]])
#nodelabels(bg = "yellow", adj = 0, cex=.5, width=.006, height=.006)
left<-rep("black",nrow(obj$trees[[1]]$edge))
nodes<-getDescendants(obj$trees[[1]],115)
left[sapply(nodes,function(x,y) which(y==x),y=obj$trees[[1]]$edge[,2])]<-
  "deepskyblue"
nodes<-getDescendants(obj$trees[[1]],124)
left[sapply(nodes,function(x,y) which(y==x),y=obj$trees[[1]]$edge[,2])]<-
  "purple"
nodes<-getDescendants(obj$trees[[1]],127)
left[sapply(nodes,function(x,y) which(y==x),y=obj$trees[[1]]$edge[,2])]<-
  "orange"

#plot(obj$trees[[2]])
#nodelabels(bg = "yellow", adj = 0, cex=.5, width=.006, height=.006)

right<-rep("black",nrow(obj$trees[[2]]$edge))
nodes<-getDescendants(obj$trees[[2]],115)
right[sapply(nodes,function(x,y) which(y==x),y=obj$trees[[2]]$edge[,2])]<-
  "deepskyblue"
nodes<-getDescendants(obj$trees[[2]],122)
right[sapply(nodes,function(x,y) which(y==x),y=obj$trees[[2]]$edge[,2])]<-
  "purple"
nodes<-getDescendants(obj$trees[[2]],127)
right[sapply(nodes,function(x,y) which(y==x),y=obj$trees[[2]]$edge[,2])]<-
  "orange"
edge.col<-list(left=left,right=right)

plot(obj,fsize=0.5,edge.col=edge.col,tip.lty=0,tip.len=0,pts=FALSE,link.type="curved")
legend("topleft",legend=c("Decomposer", "Inopinata","Ectomycorrhizal"),inset=0,pch=15, col=c("deepskyblue","purple","orange"),adj=0,  cex=0.7, pt.cex=1.25, bty="n",y.intersp = 1, title="Clade")
```

```{r, label="phylANOVA Ben tree",fig.height=6, fig.width=7, fig.align='center', echo=FALSE, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Drop outgroup for phylanova

tree2 <- read.nexus("trees/Bentree_timed_with_nucLSU.tre")
new_tips <- read.csv("spreadsheets/tip_update.csv")
tree2$tip.label <- as.character(new_tips[[2]][match(tree2$tip.label, new_tips[[1]])])

# Match tree and data

compData2 <- treedata(tree2, pcs_spores)
compTree2 <- compData2$phy
compData2 <- compData2$data %>% data.frame()
compData2[,2:4] <- sapply(compData2[,2:4], as.character) %>% as.numeric
compTree2 <- compTree2 %>% ladderize(right=F) 

amanita_only_tree <- extract.clade(compTree2, node=88) 

compData_phylANOVA <- treedata(amanita_only_tree, pcs_spores)
compTree_phylANOVA <- compData_phylANOVA$phy
compData_phylANOVA <- compData_phylANOVA$data %>% data.frame()
compData_phylANOVA[,2:4] <- sapply(compData_phylANOVA[,2:4], as.character) %>% as.numeric
compData_phylANOVA <- join(compData_phylANOVA,groups,match="first")

# Now make A. codinae, A. singeri, A. pruitii and A. inopinata group 1 since the tree is different
compData_phylANOVA$clade <- gsub("clade_2","clade_1",compData_phylANOVA$clade)


compData_phylANOVA_clade<-compData_phylANOVA$clade
names(compData_phylANOVA_clade)<-row.names(compData_phylANOVA)
compData_phylANOVA_PC1<-compData_phylANOVA$PC1
names(compData_phylANOVA_PC1)<-row.names(compData_phylANOVA)

phylANOVA(compTree_phylANOVA, compData_phylANOVA_clade, compData_phylANOVA_PC1, nsim=1000, posthoc=F, p.adj="holm")
```

## Fig. S3

```{r, label="PC1-Q regression",fig.height=6, results="hide",fig.width=8, fig.align='center',eval=T, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
row.names(spore_length_width)<-spore_length_width$species
spore_length_width$Q<-spore_length_width$ave_length__m/spore_length_width$ave_width__m
spore_length_width$cuberootVolume<-((4/3)*pi*spore_length_width$ave_length__m*spore_length_width$ave_width__m^2)^(1/3)
spore_length_width$logcuberootVolume<-log(spore_length_width$cuberootVolume)

compData_length_width <- treedata(compTree, data=spore_length_width)
compTree_length_width<-compData_length_width$phy
compData_length_width <- compData_length_width$data %>% data.frame()
compData_length_width[,c(3:7)] <- sapply(compData_length_width[,c(3:7)], as.character) %>% as.numeric

compDataPC1<-treedata(compTree_length_width,data=pcs_spores)
compDataPC1 <- compDataPC1$data %>% data.frame()
compDataPC1[,c(2:4)] <- sapply(compDataPC1[,c(2:4)], as.character) %>% as.numeric

Q_PC1_comp<-data.frame(Q=compData_length_width[sort(row.names(compData_length_width)),colnames(compData_length_width)=="Q"], 
                       PC1=compDataPC1[sort(row.names(compDataPC1)),colnames(compDataPC1)=="PC1"])

cor.test(Q_PC1_comp$Q,Q_PC1_comp$PC1)

ggscatter(Q_PC1_comp, x = "Q", y = "PC1", 
          add = "reg.line", conf.int = TRUE, 
          cor.coef = TRUE, cor.method = "pearson",
          xlab = "Q", ylab = "PC1")

```

```{r, label="phylogenetic ANOVA volume",fig.height=6,,fig.width=8, fig.align='center',eval=T, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
compData_phylANOVA_volume_clade<-compData_phylANOVA_volume$clade
names(compData_phylANOVA_volume_clade)<-row.names(compData_phylANOVA_volume)
compData_phylANOVA_volume_logcuberootVolume<-compData_phylANOVA_volume$logcuberootVolume
names(compData_phylANOVA_volume_logcuberootVolume)<-row.names(compData_phylANOVA_volume)

phylANOVA(compTree_phylANOVA_volume, compData_phylANOVA_volume_clade, compData_phylANOVA_volume_logcuberootVolume, nsim=1000, posthoc=F, p.adj="holm")

```


```{r, label="Ornstein-Uhlenbeck on volume calculation",fig.height=6, results="hide",fig.width=8, fig.align='center',eval=T, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Volume<-as.matrix(compData_length_width[,c(5:7)])[,3]

l1ouVolumetree<-adjust_data(compTree_length_width,Volume)
set.seed(101)
estimate_shift_Volume<-estimate_shift_configuration(l1ouVolumetree$tree, l1ouVolumetree$Y, criterion="pBIC")
```

```{r, label="Ornstein-Uhlenbeck on volume bootstrap",fig.height=6, results="hide",fig.width=8, fig.align='center',eval=F, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
result<-l1ou_bootstrap_support(estimate_shift_Volume,nItrs=100)
saveRDS(result, "results/result_log_cuberoot_volume_bootstrap_analysis.rds")
```

```{r, label="Ornstein-Uhlenbeck on volume",fig.height=6, results="hide",fig.width=8, fig.align='center',eval=T, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
result_Volume<-readRDS("results/result_log_cuberoot_volume_bootstrap_analysis.rds")
nEdges_Volume <- Nedge(l1ouVolumetree$tree)
e.w_Volume <- rep(1,nEdges_Volume) 
e.w_Volume[estimate_shift_Volume$shift.configuration] <- 3
e.l_Volume <- round(result_Volume$detection.rate*100, digits=1)
e.l_Volume <- ifelse(e.l_Volume>20, paste0(e.l_Volume,"%"), NA)

##update tip labels
estimate_shift_Volume$tree$tip.label<-as.character(new_tips[[3]][match(estimate_shift_Volume$tree$tip.label, new_tips[[2]])])
row.names(estimate_shift_Volume$Y)<-as.character(new_tips[[3]][match(row.names(estimate_shift_Volume$Y), new_tips[[2]])])

plot(estimate_shift_Volume, edge.label=e.l_Volume, edge.ann.cex=0.7, edge.label.ann=TRUE, cex=0.5, label.offset=0.02, edge.width=e.w_Volume)
```
